Latency is elapsed time per operation; throughput is completed operations per unit time; percentiles
describe the latency distribution.
Latency කියන්Jන් එක request එකට ගතවන Jවලාව. Throughput කියන්Jන් තත්පෙරයකදී අවසන්
කරන requests ගණන. p95 වලින් requests 95%ක් ඒ අගයට Jහහෝ ඊට අඩු latency එකකින් අවසන්
A shop averages 100 ms but some requests take seconds.
Read the diagram: p50: 80 ms~80; p95: 250 ms~250; p99: 900 ms~900
Bars දිග අනුව latency අගයන් සංසන්දනය කරන්න.

# Example dashboard
p50 = 80ms; p95 = 250ms; p99 = 900ms
throughput = 500 requests/s
Expected result: Tail latency reveals slow requests that an average can hide.

Why monitor p99 rather than only average latency?
It reveals the experience of the slowest fraction of requests.
